issues.title: Incomplete Installer Templates
issues.why: The spec provides logic fragments for Bash/PowerShell but lacks a complete, copy-pasteable 'Golden Template' for the installers, forcing the AI to synthesize the glue code.
issues.fix: Add a '08-installer-templates.md' containing the full, un-truncated source for install.sh and install.ps1 with all placeholders.

issues.title: Missing Concurrency Implementation
issues.why: AC-21 and 02-release-pipeline defer concurrency logic to spec/13 via cross-reference, but a mediocre AI without web access cannot resolve that external link.
issues.fix: In-line the specific SQLite/locking shell commands required for the release pipeline's local state management.

issues.title: Ambiguous 'dist' cleanup logic
issues.why: 05-release-assets.md provides a shell loop for cleanup that might delete the newly created .tar.gz if the globbing or extension check is slightly off in different shells.
issues.fix: Provide a specific, tested 'find' command or explicit list of files to keep to avoid accidental deletion of assets.
